title: Review verdict
description: Typed result of one code-review round, keyed to the git head SHA it reviewed.

artifact_class.description: What kind of change was reviewed; selects the lens roster the round's staffing decision draws from.

base_sha.description: Full git object id the diff was taken against.

head_sha.description: Full git object id of the reviewed head; the verdict is valid only for this commit.

claim_id.description: Identifier of the completion claim this round adjudicates.

retained_categories.description: Categories carried forward from earlier rounds; an empty array means nothing retained.

digest.description: Digest of the staffing record's raw bytes. The lens set this round had to cover is that record's, so the verdict names which bytes it is answerable to; a record edited after the round no longer matches.

path.description: Where the staffing record was read from. A locating hint only — the digest, not this string, is what identifies the record.

staffing_record.description: Reference to the staffing decision this round was dispatched from. The record itself lives beside the verdict, not inside it.

vendor.description: Vendor of the model that produced this report. The count of distinct vendors across the lenses is the round's diversity; one distinct vendor means it collapsed.

transport.description: Route the prompt actually went out on — not the route the lens registry declared for it.

model.description: Model that actually produced this report.

transport_error.description: The verbatim error the declared route returned, when the swap was forced by that route failing rather than chosen. Verbatim because a paraphrase cannot be matched against.

substitution.description: Present only when this lens ran on something other than what its registry entry declared; names what was declared and why the substitute was used.

lenses.description: Every lens the round's staffing decision staffed, reported individually, green ones included, each recording what actually ran it.

work_item.description: Identifier of the work item a transferred finding was filed as. A defect ruled out of scope stays accounted for only if something outside this campaign now carries it.

allOf.description: A transfer moves a finding out of the campaign, so it carries both halves of the claim it rests on: evidence holding the provenance basis that the defect predates the change, and the work item now accountable for it. Either half alone lets a live defect leave the campaign unowned.

prior_dispositions.description: One entry per mechanical finding from every prior round's posted verdict.

failures.description: Every transport failure the round hit and did not recover from, in order, each with the verbatim error it returned. At least two, because the halting condition is a lens whose declared route died and whose failover died as well; more when parallel dispatches exhausted their routes together. A failure a successful failover recovered from belongs on that lens's substitution, not here. A policy that halts on a particular provider error reads this.

abandoned_lenses.description: Staffed lenses that were never dispatched because the round stopped. Empty only when the round stopped on its last lens.

oneOf.description: The round lost a lens's declared route and its failover with it, so it stopped rather than reporting the gap as coverage.

indicted_finding.description: Id of the finding that indicts the acceptance criteria or requirements themselves, rather than the artifact measured against them.

indicted_artifact.description: Path of the upstream artifact the finding indicts — the ruler, not the work.

artifact_digest.description: Digest of the indicted artifact's content at the moment of the halt. A resume recomputes it: an unchanged digest means the ruler is still bent and the request is refused.

abandoned_lenses.description: Staffed lenses that were never dispatched because the round stopped. Empty only when the round stopped on its last lens.

oneOf.description: A finding indicted the criteria the round measures against. No further round is run: every one of them would measure against a ruler known to be bent, so there is no transport to fail over to and no failure list to carry.

halt.description: Present exactly when the verdict is halted: why the round stopped and what it never looked at. The reason selects the shape — the two halts carry different evidence because they are stopped by different things.

downgraded_from.description: Present only on an advisory the harvester demoted because the lens marked it mechanical and supplied no evidence.

allOf.description: On typed code a fix is checkable, so a fixed finding names the test and the fails-without/passes-with observation that shows it. Classes with no test gate keep evidence optional on fixed, where the same demand would only buy prose.
